provider.name: UNITE
provider.organization_type: global fungal ITS sequence, species-hypothesis, taxonomy, reference-sequence, community-curation, DOI-release, classifier-training, API, and download infrastructure
provider.description: UNITE is a curated reference database for fungal internal transcribed spacer sequences. It organizes sequences into versioned species hypotheses with stable SH identifiers and DOIs, maintains curated fungal taxonomy and reference sequences, supports community annotation through PlutoF, and publishes downloadable releases for molecular identification, metabarcoding, ecology, and classifier training.
institutional_context: International fungal taxonomists, sequence archives, culture collections, and metabarcoding communities

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting UNITE documentation, organization, fungal ITS sequences, species hypotheses, SH identifiers and DOIs, taxonomy, reference sequences, metadata, release packages, PlutoF curation, APIs, formats, validation methods, pipeline integrations, licenses, citations, software, standards, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: UNITE, PlutoF, official release repositories and DOIs, INSDC source records, fungal nomenclatural authorities, type material, cited publications, and official repositories remain authoritative for sequences, accessions, species hypotheses, taxonomy, identifiers, versions, rights, and contacts.
